arguments.sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id)
     FROM Player AS p WHERE p.height > 180) AS repeated_or_missing_player_ids,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TYPEOF(p.height))
     FROM Player AS p) AS height_types,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TYPEOF(pa.heading_accuracy))
     FROM Player_Attributes AS pa) AS heading_accuracy_types,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
     WHERE EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM Player AS p
         WHERE p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id AND p.height > 180
     )) AS matching_attribute_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
     JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
     WHERE p.height > 180) AS joined_attribute_rows

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND pa.heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10
